ctx.x: At the time when they were subdividing and putting this new area over here right outside of Pasadena called Flint-ridge and La Crescenta, when they were subdividing, we -- my dad played for subdivisions of all of that. He used to play for the clambakes down at what is now Palos Verdes off the beach, when they were subdividing that, when it was nothing but ground. He played for the subdivisions of those things and he was able to name his own price for jobs and so in doing so, he also had as his clientele Marco…
He played for the stag parties for Jack Warner and Warner Brothers, things like that. The first time I ever went to a stag party and saw what a real stag party was was the big-

time party they gave at the Beverly Hills Riding Academy for Jack Warner when he was taking his first trip to Europe. I was very, very low teenager. I was -- as a matter of fact, it was in 1926, so you can add from 1926 from 1912 and you'll get it. I was 14 years old. I worked with the family orchestra at this big stag party and the funny thing is nobody actually knew it was a stag party. My dad didn't know it was a stag party because when the call came in, my father took his regular orchestra out there, which…
